subject: Post-demo recap — buying decision map & attack surface kickoff for CoreFin
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Barnes <obarnes@corefin.com>; Meera Patel <meera.patel@corefin.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T15:22:00Z
Subject: Post-demo recap — buying lanes, decision map & next steps

Hi Oliver / Meera —

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — great conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we all have the same picture: 

1) Buying lanes and decision roles (as discussed)
   - Economic buyer: Oliver Barnes (VP, Payments) — controls budget for ML infra
   - Procurement lead: Meera Patel — handles contract & vendor onboarding
   - Security contact: CoreFin Security team (security@corefin.com) — will run the questionnaire + system boundary review
   - Product owner / integrator: Samir Rana (internal) — will own integration

2) Primary decision criteria you listed: 
   - Latency under 150ms p95 for standard requests
   - RSA-compliant key management and SOC2 evidence
   - Predictable billing with reserved capacity option

3) Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm):
   - I’ll share our standard security questionnaire and a short list of the systems that would be in scope for the initial integration (see attachment).
   - Meera / Procurement: propose timeline for contract review and any internal PO process — target: EOW 9/24 for procurement readiness.
   - Security: please confirm primary systems in scope (Prod APIs, internal logging, S3 backups?) and any additional evidence you need beyond the questionnaire.

Attached: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf and a working econ-buyer roster template.

If that looks right I’ll open a dedicated shared folder and schedule a 30-min security kickoff next week.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0187

From: Oliver Barnes <obarnes@corefin.com>

Date: 2026-09-13T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — buying lanes, decision map & next steps

Hey Marissa —

This matches my notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed econ buyer: yes, I own the budget and am the sign-off for the pilot.
- Procurement timeline: Meera and I aligned — we can complete vendor paperwork and PO approval by 9/24 if we get the contract draft and any SOWs by next Wednesday (9/16).
- Security scope: Our initial scope will be "customer-facing APIs" + "data-at-rest in S3" (we are excluding analytics data lake for the pilot).

Meera — can you confirm if we need our legal team to pre-sign any NDAs or if the standard Redwood MSA is fine to circulate?

Oliver

From: CoreFin Security <security@corefin.com>

Cc: Meera Patel <meera.patel@corefin.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — buying lanes, decision map & next steps

Marissa / Oliver —

Thanks for the clear recap. I’m Meera (security point) filling in for initial intake — attaching our completed intake form and a short note on systems. We received the Redwood questionnaire and have started populating answers; a couple of quick asks so we can reduce back-and-forth: 

1) Clarify where KV cache and model artifacts will live for the pilot. Are artifacts stored in customer S3 or Redwood-managed buckets?
2) Do you support customer-managed KMS (we have an internal KMS policy and will likely require CMK access)?
3) For audit logs: what fields do you capture for model inference requests (user id, request id, timestamp, token counts)?

We attached: 
- CoreFin_Security_Intake_answers_draft.xlsx (short answers + missing fields flagged)
- Prod_Services_in_scope.csv (inventory of endpoints we think are in scope for pilot)

We can join a 30-min kickoff on 9/16 at 14:00 ET — Laura, Rishi, Marissa, please confirm.

Regards,
Meera Patel
Security Analyst — CoreFin
security@corefin.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Meera Patel <meera.patel@corefin.com>, Oliver Barnes <obarnes@corefin.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — buying lanes, decision map & next steps

Thanks Meera — this is perfect. Quick confirmations and actions from Redwood: 

- KV cache & model artifacts: For the pilot we can support storing model artifacts in a customer-owned S3 (recommended) or Redwood-managed object store — we’ll mark customer S3 as default for CoreFin because you prefer CMK.
- Customer-managed KMS: Yes, Redwood supports CMK integrations; Laura will follow up with our KMS requirements and an integration checklist.
- Audit logs: Redwood can surface request id, timestamp, token counts, and anonymized user identifier by default; we’ll export a sample schema before the kickoff.

Next actions: 
- I’ll upload the completed Redwood questionnaire with explicit answers to the shared Drive by EOD 9/16.
- Laura B. will send the KMS integration doc and a short artifact-storage decision note by 9/17.
- Meeting: Confirmed — security kickoff 9/16 14:00 ET (we will use the shared drive doc as the working artifact).

If anything changes, ping me. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa

Account Executive, Redwood Inference
